name: 会话智能已读标记器
description: 在打卡动作执行前主动清除未读红点，还原真人点击会话并阅读的自然行为。
author: TG-SignPulse

params_schema.name: delay_seconds
params_schema.label: 等待时长(秒)
params_schema.description: 标记已读前等待的秒数 (0 为立即标记)

params_schema.name: private_only
params_schema.label: 仅私聊生效
params_schema.description: 是否仅对一对一私聊生效，群组和频道跳过

description_en: Proactively marks chat messages as read to clear unread badges before actions, mimicking natural human reading behavior.
features: Automatically marks chat history as read
